name: Odd-variable Boolean nonlinearity: exceed 242, 996 or 4040
compute_profile: laptop-hours to laptop-days for symmetry-restricted search and local modifications; a full Walsh certificate takes milliseconds to seconds
statement: Claude Carlet, Marko Ðurasevic, Domagoj Jakobovic, Stjepan Picek and Luca Mariot, A Systematic Study on the Design of Odd-Sized Highly Nonlinear Boolean Functions via Evolutionary Algorithms (arXiv:2504.17666v1, April 2025; journal publication December 2025), describe maximum nonlinearity for odd n>7 as open. Table 1 gives unrestricted best-known values 242,996,4040 for n=9,11,13, and upper bounds 244,1000,4050. Nonlinearity is minimum Hamming distance to an affine Boolean function. The n=9 construction is credited to Kavut and Yücel. Direct sums of an n=9, nonlinearity-242 function with two- or four-variable bent functions already give 996 and 4040. These compositions belong to the bar. Author spellings here follow the cited preprint.
success_criterion: Supply the complete truth table of f:{0,1}^n→{0,1}, for n=9,11 or 13, with nonlinearity strictly greater than 242,996 or4040 respectively. No balancedness, rotation symmetry or algebraic-degree restriction is imposed. Report the full Walsh spectrum and the exact achieved nonlinearity; the checker recomputes it. Also strictly improve the best comparable published result at claim time, including compatible compositions of published objects. State whether the candidate is a composition and identify its components. Values in unmerged pull requests do not set the bar.
verification_method: Validate 2^n Boolean table entries in explicitly specified lexicographic bit order. Apply the integer fast Walsh–Hadamard transform to (-1)^f(x). Compute NL(f)=2^(n−1)−max_a |W_f(a)|/2, which includes distances to both affine constants. Check Parseval sum_a W_f(a)^2=2^(2n) and compare the exact integer result with the threshold. This requires at most 8192×13 additions and no floating-point tolerance.
status_checked: 2026-10-15 (supplied literature-status date; primary publication re-read 2026-10-24, later literature not independently rechecked)
angles: Explore generalized rotation-symmetric orbits, but verify the expanded unrestricted truth table.
Use incremental Walsh updates for small truth-table moves and optimize the largest coefficients first.
Search secondary constructions from the n=9 examples while tracking exact spectral changes.
pitfalls: Balanced-function records do not set unrestricted thresholds.
Semi-bent values are below the records here.
A Walsh spectrum alone is not a function certificate; include the truth table.
The established bent-function compositions already attain 996 and 4040.
Later unrestricted records were not independently rechecked.
